author: TreeFiddy33
title: Half game, half ads
content:
It was a good, chill game at first but after so many rounds the ad placement becomes extremely disruptive. A normal round can take up to a minute or two but a minute long ad is inserted between every round. If you reach a tough round and  fail you are presented with two options “Continue” or “Restart.” Continue has an ad icon leading you to believe if you select it you will have to watch an ad. Restart does not have the icon. However, no matter the option you will be forced to watch another ad.

Dev did a solid job with the UI/UX. I rarely accidentally tap the wrong arrow even when completely zoomed out from the board. The challenge progression is ok. Even at level 110 it seems the difficulty has remained relatively the same from the earlier levels. Though I have enjoyed the game, the ad experience is wearing me down and I’ll most likely move on to something else. It was good while it lasted.

author: Hshdkc
title: The BEST Arrows Game!!
content: This is the perfect arrow game. It’s exactly what it claims to be. I would see ads for all these fun looking arrow games, download them, and then the game was nothing like what the ad showed. This game is, and exactly what I was looking for. You clear arrows, no tricks or shady play. You don’t have to earn coins to get extra lives, or buy hints, and they don’t force ads on you here! The ads are very appropriate, if you need a hint, watch an ad, simple and appropriate. I also love how if it’s been a bit since you’ve hit an arrow, it will tell you how many are open to be moved at that point. This is a wonderful, straight forward game!!
